name: EthOS Download Manager
description: HTTP, magnet and debrid downloads with a priority queue, categories, a daily schedule, bandwidth limits and RSS rules — in a native EthOS window.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.2: matches the shared package shell — a persistent Download button in the window header, a ready/attention status card, numbered add form (source · destination · torrents), table-based categories/RSS/watch folders and a Package panel; the 2 s poll no longer clears the quick-add field. 1.0.1: debrid keys can be verified without re-typing them (the backend uses the saved key for a masked value), provider errors are shown verbatim (e.g. Real-Debrid bad_token, AllDebrid auth errors, TorBox /user/me), and admin-only saves explain the 403. 1.0.0: first release — live queue with drag-and-drop ordering, pause/resume/reset/delete, add via URL, magnet or .torrent, categories, a daily start window, global/per-task speed limits, debrid provider setup, qBittorrent key management, RSS rules and watch folders.
